description: Source code for the 'Function' class implementation in PyTorch's JIT mobile module, handling bytecode instructions, operator initialization, and schema management.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Represents a mobile JIT function, managing instructions, operators, constants, types, and schema.

methods.name: append_instruction
methods.description: Adds an instruction with debug handle to the function's code.

methods.name: append_operator
methods.description: Adds an operator name and overload to the function's code.

methods.name: initialize_operators
methods.description: Initializes operators used in the function, checking support and loading operator functions.

methods.name: append_constant
methods.description: Appends a constant value to the function's code.

methods.name: append_type
methods.description: Appends a type to the function's code.

methods.name: set_register_size
methods.description: Sets the register size for the function.

methods.name: get_debug_handle
methods.description: Retrieves the debug handle for a given program counter.

methods.name: setSchema
methods.description: Sets the schema for the function.

methods.name: hasSchema
methods.description: Checks if the function has a schema.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the function with a given stack.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Calls run() and returns the top of the stack.

methods.name: num_inputs
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs based on the schema.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Initializes operators and executes a provided function with the code.

methods.name: registerFunc
methods.description: Registers a new function with instructions, constants, types, and register size.
